dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000si4j](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000si4j) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 192.58 depth occurred on Mar 21 2026 68 km WNW of San Antonio de los Cobres, Argentina. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -24.0759 longitude -66.977. It impacted 911 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
